create_rigids_from_3_points: create rigid transformations from 3 points using Gram Schmidt orthogonalization
invert_rigids: compute the group inverse of rigid transformations including rotation and translation
compose_rigids: compose two rigid transformations by multiplying rotations and transforming translations
convert_rigids_to_flat9: convert rigid transformations to flat9 encoding with first two rotation columns and translation
normalize_vecs: normalize 3D vectors using robust normalization with epsilon regularization to avoid division by zero
